recognition.summary: Compliant disclosures may receive public credit at Cigna's discretion; reporters can opt out.

reporting.summary: The official policy provides direct security-team email reporting and encryption guidance.

rewards.summary: The policy offers no compensation beyond possible public recognition.

limitations: Anonymous reports are accepted but receive no public acknowledgment.
Protected personal and health information must remain confidential even after remediation.
